steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The exit is right ahead. Hella, take the Chief out of here and stay clear of this place.
She takes your hand and rushes you along out of the passage.
As soon as Hecate steps out of the passage, she turns around and sets the Nightmare on the upper part of the exit. Instantaneously, huge blocks of sandstone come crashing down and block the exit.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Phew... Great. I was worried that they would turn liquid and seep out through the cracks. Those guys, and this place, were just so damn creepy.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't let your guard down. We're out of the passage, but that's no guarantee that we're already out of the woods.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, can you sense the distance between us and the inheritance?
...No need to sense. At the end of the passage is a wide, deep pit. You are standing near its edge, looking down.
The pit is near 100 meters in diameter. The lone narrow lane spirals downwards to the bottom, connecting with a lonely island that floats at the very center.
In the heart of the island stands a stone altar, lifeless and chilling.
